Noel Noa (ノエル・ノア, Noeru Noa?) is a 31-year-old forward from France who is a Boss of a famous yet dangerous mafia in France. Noa is currently known as the most dangerous mafia boss in the France. Over a decade ago, he was Jinpachi Ego's former partner in crime/rival.

Appearance
Noa is a tall pale skinned man with a muscular frame. His hair is white and his eyes are yellow with black-shaded eyelids.

Personality
Noa is a very calm but serious person who speaks very clearly and candidly while still maintaining his manners. He is described by fellow football colleagues as a cyborg because of his very serious and non-expressive demeanor. He does not like when his players try to act superior to others and regards it as childish. Noa admits that he does not take into consideration intangible factors like impressions or emotion but only a player’s numbers and the results that come from those numbers when picking his team, but if he is inclined to play a player due to their popularity and any contracts, he is beholden to, then he will forsake his earlier judgment.

Having grown up poor in the slums of France, Noa has taken his criminal behavior such as stilling and such very seriously from a young age because it was the only way for him to change his life. Around his fellow world-class criminals, Noa’s serious demeanor is found annoying by his more expressive and reckless colleagues as he ignores them and their statements of being the best.

Just because Noa is cold and serious does not mean he is not a good person at heart, he's kind hearted and a gentlemen.
